caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular composition centered on a plain cream background. The rectangle has a decorative border with a zigzag pattern in black, red, yellow, and green. Inside the border, the background is solid black. In the center of the black area, there is a pink bird with a white and red-striped tail and white markings on its wing. The bird is surrounded by several stylized floral and leaf shapes in colors including red, orange, yellow, purple, green, and white. Some flowers have circular centers with radiating petals, and there are small red and white berries scattered throughout. The elements are arranged symmetrically, filling the black space with both large and small floral motifs and leaves.
title: Plate 44: Painted Chest Design: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
